title: After the Shuka Sho: Witch's Dignity

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho! It's Sweep Tosho! Sweep Tosho sweeps right to the front!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And Sweep Tosho crosses the finish line first! Sweep Tosho has seized the full glory of the Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Amazing! Amazing! This is the first time I've seen such a fierce, courageous, and feisty generation of runners!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: And Sweep Tosho beat them all! Did you see how fast she was going at the end?!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Remember what she was saying? She said she was going to change the world, change the way things are. You know, just maybe…

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: …Yeah. You know, I think Sweep Tosho might really be able to pull it off!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: (That was… fun… Really fun! And…)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: (The way the crowd looked at me! Their eyes were different today! Yeah… my magic's getting stronger!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: Aghhh! I lost!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Aha… Yeah. I won!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Wait… Are you crying?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: Obviously! I'm upset! Aghhh!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: You know, at first, you really made me mad. I didn't like the way you acted like you represented the whole Triple Tiara tour.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you already told me that… So? What about now?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: Hm… Well, you still make me mad.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What?! Hold on!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: But I respect you… You were the strongest out of everyone.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: So go ahead and be our representative. Get out there and change the world.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Blue Ribbons
text_block_list.text: As the Tiara tour's little witch.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Munch, munch…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having won the Shuka Sho in spectacular fashion, Sweep Tosho achieves a result befitting the representative of the Triple Tiara tour.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But she remains as demanding as ever. She suddenly demands ice cream on our way home, so we stop for some.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Mmm! …So, about my next race!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What? Were you zoning out just then?! Familiar! That's not allowed!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You have to stay alert! My racing magic's almost ready, after all.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Back then, I wanted to run in special races to make my racing magic stronger. And now, look how far I've come…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: During the Oka Sho, and in the interview after, a tiny seed was planted. And at the Japanese Oaks, that seed finally sprouted.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: But wow, seeing the other racers get all fired up was so much fun… My magic even worked on Rob Roy!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: And you saw what happened at the Shuka Sho, right?! I bet at least half the people who were there are under my spell now too!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You know, I'm starting to get what makes a race special.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Like you said, it's important that the race itself is a special one. It's gotta be a race everyone really wants to see.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: But I'm pretty sure that a race needs two other things too!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: One is a special rival! You've gotta have an opponent who's mega pumped, like that girl with the blue ribbons in her hair.
choice_data_list: I see… And what's the other thing?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: The other thing is that I have to be special myself.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Like by being a girl who announces in an interview that she's gonna cast magic… or a girl who represents the Triple Tiara tour.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: So I'm gonna run in a special race against special rivals, and I'm gonna be the most special Umamusume of all!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm pretty sure that'll make it an ultra fun race, and then, when all that magical energy is charged up inside me…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I should definitely be able to cast my magic on the whole world.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: No, there's no "should" about it! I'm gonna cast my magic on everyone, and that's that!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: So listen up, Familiar. I'm gonna run in the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Just being this year's Triple Tiara tour representative isn't enough!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna become even more special—by racing against the senior-year runners who came from the Triple Tiara tour!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Classic year, senior year, none of that stuff matters to me!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna represent the runners on all the Triple Tiara tours!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho showcases her ambitions with a series of confident claims.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's times like these when she's more stubborn, more headstrong, more obstinate…
choice_data_list: All right. Next up is the Queen Elizabeth II Cup!
All right. Next up is the Queen Elizabeth II Cup!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …And also more incredible than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: That's that, then! Okay, time to head back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: And when we get back, you need to get to work! You've gotta work super hard for me. ♪
